title: Report: "Noise" about Aaron Rodgers and Cardinals "not at all" real

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: "Noise" about Aaron Rodgers and Cardinals "not at all" real
sources.description: The Steelers' recent decision to apply the unrestricted free agency tender to quarterback Aaron Rodgers has sparked speculation as to whether Rodgers may be thinking about signing with another team.
